metrics.method: Full history 2026-05-25 to 2026-09-17, 1066 non-service messages (695 Lilia / 371 ALTR). client_questions_total = client messages containing a direct ask (question mark, or an explicit instruction/request to the team such as 'please tell', 'can u', 'let ur chatters know'). unanswered_over_24h = of those, the ones with no ALTR reply in the same thread within 24h (20); on the OnlyFans topic alone, 26 client asks went >24h with no reply from the account owner Fred. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between any two consecutive ALTR messages (4.4d, 2026-08-04 -> 2026-08-09); excluding templated broadcasts and bare @-tag pings the longest substantive silence is 6.0d (2026-09-08 -> 2026-09-14), and the account owner's longest silence is 11.0d (2026-09-04 -> 2026-09-15). Promises = explicit forward commitments by ALTR staff in-chat ('I'll speak to the team', 'will inform team', 'I will take them off your account', 'last change I promise'); kept = a verifiable action or report-back in the chat; lapsed = never mentioned again or demonstrably broken; the remaining 4 are open and not yet due.

top_fix: Stop answering complaints with 'I'll speak to the team' and install one mechanical control instead: a hard purchase-history check in the CRM before any PPV goes to a named high spender, plus her $200/$200/$100-per-minute price floor written into the CRM rather than briefed verbally - and make every complaint close in writing with a named person and a date. Eleven old-content escalations, two lost high spenders, four price escalations and 56 days of an unnamed chatter all trace back to the same root cause: we have never once replaced a verbal briefing with a control, so every fix we promise her decays within days.
